text.content: Failure 3: Hallucination on tool failure

rich_text.plain_text: Failure 3: Hallucination on tool failure

text.content: During three test sessions, the HTTP Node returned a 504 timeout error. In all three cases, the agent ignored the error and generated a fabricated engagement status including specific phase names and milestone dates that were not present in any returned data. Review of the Agent Node's system prompt reveals no instruction governing what the agent should do when the HTTP Node returns an error code. The agent defaulted to general helpfulness and filled the information gap with plausible-sounding fabrication.

text.content: Checkpoint:

rich_text.plain_text: Checkpoint:

text.content: A vague instruction like "do not guess" tells the agent what not to do but leaves the next action undefined. A probabilistic model defaults to helpfulness meaning it generates a plausible continuation regardless. Writing the exact fallback phrase inside the instruction gives the agent a concrete output to produce. Include three elements: acknowledge the information is unavailable, avoid implying the agent found a result, and direct the consultant to a specific next step.

rich_text.plain_text: Takeaway:

text.content: Production refinement is about removing failure modes. The three fixes in this lesson (model optimisation, description precision, and error handling instructions) each address a specific, evidence-based failure identified in execution traces. Targeted fixes grounded in trace evidence are significantly more reliable than iterative prompt tweaking guided by intuition.
